channel.title: Listworthy | App posts
channel.description: Fun posts about Listworthy, the free ranking and list app for iPhone.

item.title: Blind Ranking game: rank 10 movies with no take-backs on iPhone
item.description:
🙈 Blind Ranking in 3 steps:
1. On the Rank tab, tap a category like Movies or Games. 2. Pick Blind Ranking in the sheet. 3. 10 titles show up one at a time. Put each one in a slot from 1 to 10 before you see the next. No take-backs, and you get 3 skips for ones you don't know.
Ever lock something in at #1 and regret it two picks later?
#Listworthy
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: Christmas gift list app with a budget: track who gets what before Black Friday
item.description:

Listworthy gift lists keep track of who gets what, what it costs and what's already bought. Set a budget and watch the total as you go.
Saw something good in Amazon or another store app? Tap Share and send it straight to your list.
Who's the first name on your list this year?
#Listworthy #GiftIdeas

item.title: Rank your recipes: which dinner recipe was better? A recipe app tip
item.description:
🍝 Hidden tip for recipe people:
Mark 2 or more recipes as made, open the Made it filter and tap "Which was better?"
Pick between two at a time and Listworthy ranks your recipes for you. Finally settles the chili debate.
What recipe would win in your house?
#Listworthy #Recipes

item.title: Desert Island game: keep only your 5 favorites from any list
item.description:
🏝️ Hidden tip: your own lists can go to a desert island too.
Long-press any list with 8 or more items and tap "Desert Island: keep 5."
Pack 5, leave the rest behind, then tap Lock in my 5. Share your island as a story card when you're done.
Which 5 from your list survive the trip?
#Listworthy
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: Higher or Lower: a free movie, TV and video game guessing game for iPhone
item.description:
🎬 New game in Listworthy: Higher or Lower.
Does the next movie score higher or lower than the last one? One wrong guess ends the run.
It works for movies, TV, games and books. Albums and comics play by release year instead.
Start on the Rank tab: tap a category, then Higher or Lower.
What's your best streak? Post it below.
#Listworthy
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: How to save Thanksgiving recipes from Pinterest as clean recipe cards
item.description:

What's the one dish your table can't skip?
#Listworthy #ThanksgivingRecipes

item.title: How to share a ranked list with friends: Send a Copy in Listworthy
item.description:
📲 New in Listworthy: Send a Copy.
Open any list, tap Share, then Send a Copy. Your friend taps the link and gets the whole list in their Listworthy, posters, scores, tiers and notes included.
Now you can finally prove your top 10 is better than theirs.
Who's getting your list first?
#Listworthy
Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/listworthy/id6752911163?ppid=36eddce0-e99d-46b7-b73b-88ec00af83a9&pt=128166069&ct=fb-app&mt=8

item.title: How to make a holiday gift list with a budget in 3 steps
item.description:
🎁 Holiday gift list in 3 steps:
1. Tap + on the Lists tab and filter by Gifts. 2. Found something in Amazon or another store app? Tap Share and send it to your list. 3. Set a budget, note who gets what, and check off gifts as you buy them.
Who's the hardest person on your list to shop for?
